summary: VPOS Multi-RIF Phase 1 (Comercial Entry + Data Foundation) validated end-to-end. Backend pytest: 4/4 passing (login, create multirif quote without client_id, regression VPOS with client_id, fallback no-bank). Frontend PYME and CORP flows: inverted logic confirmed (bank-as-acquirer replaces client, implicit sponsor block replaces Si/No question, 'Cajas Globales (Lote)' label, IVA exempt remains). VPOS regression: cliente selector + Si/No sponsorship question intact.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>'. Comes from a wrapping <span data-ve-dynamic style='display:contents'> injected by tooling around <tr> elements in QuotesTable.jsx (~line 306-332). Not introduced by Multi-RIF; pre-existing since iteration 70.

action_items: None blocking. (Optional, pre-existing) Fix the <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers around <tr> in QuotesTable.jsx to remove the recurring hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend QuoteCreateWithPDF.client_id is correctly Optional[str] = None and persists empty client_id when is_multirif=True (verified via GET).

Synthetic client_name 'Lote <Banco> (Multi-RIF)' is built from sponsoring_bank_name first then falls back to sponsor_bank_name and finally 'Banco' (good defensive default; verified by edge-case test).

Frontend QuoteWizardDialog.jsx correctly forces sponsored_implementation=true and clears client_id when 'VPOS_MULTIRIF' is selected (line 306-307), and the useEffect inherits sponsoring_bank_id into selectedBankId for the medios de pago section (line 73-76).

Implicit sponsor block (data-testid multirif-implicit-sponsor) and sponsor label (data-testid multirif-sponsor-label) correctly render only when isMultiRif. Banco (Adquirencia) dropdown disables Cliente in both PYME and CORP flows.

select-bank in Section 2 has disabled={isMultiRif} which matches the requirement that the bank is pre-loaded and locked once a multirif quote header is complete (verified visually in code; full Section 2 rendering requires integrator selection).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (PYME inverted form + bank select + sponsor label, CORP same inverted behavior, VPOS regression intact)

seed_data_creation: Tests create up to 3 TEST_ quotes (one VPOS_MULTIRIF, one regression VPOS, one edge-case). Teardown DELETEs them via /api/quotes/{quote_id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VPOS Multi-RIF Phase 1 fully validated. /app/backend/tests/test_multirif_phase1.py exercises the create-with-pdf endpoint with is_multirif=true and validates persistence (quote_type='VPOS_MULTIRIF', is_multirif=true, sponsored_implementation=true, sponsoring_bank_name populated, client_name='Lote <Bank> (Multi-RIF)', client_id empty). Frontend selectors used: data-testid={create-quote-button, new-impl-pyme, new-impl-corp, select-quote-type, multirif-bank-select, multirif-implicit-sponsor, multirif-sponsor-label, select-client, select-bank, sponsored-impl-block}. Note: 'sponsored-impl-block' is the SHARED wrapper that hosts EITHER the Si/No buttons (when !isMultiRif) OR the implicit sponsor block (when isMultiRif). The Si/No buttons themselves are correctly hidden under VPOS_MULTIRIF; only multirif-implicit-sponsor renders inside. Phases 2-5 (nested RIF→Tienda distribution, 3-level tracking, {Matriz_MultiRif_Distribucion} variable, bulk update) NOT yet implemented and NOT tested per request.
